task.title: M3: Precise TS resolver via the repo's typescript, with node_modules reuse rule
task.description:
Implement the precise TypeScript tier: when the analyzed checkout has a usable typescript package, resolve imports with ts.resolveModuleName using the repo's own tsconfig so the result matches what tsc sees. For non-HEAD refs analyzed in a detached worktree there is no node_modules; reuse the HEAD checkout's node_modules/typescript only if the ref's package.json pins a compatible major, otherwise fall back to the baseline resolver and record languages.ts = 'baseline' for that snapshot. The tier is recorded per snapshot so the UI can show it per ref.

Acceptance criteria:
- With typescript available, languages.ts is 'precise' and edges come from ts.resolveModuleName; project references and path mappings resolve correctly.
- For a detached ref, the HEAD node_modules/typescript is reused when majors match and skipped otherwise; both branches are unit tested.
- Fallback never fails the run; it logs why and records 'baseline'.
- The typescript module is loaded from the repo, never bundled into codeviz.
- Capacitor at HEAD analyzes as precise and a diff against the baseline edges is summarized in the PR.
